test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 16 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FLEET’ is written as ‘TFMFF’, ‘OUTLET’ is written as ‘TOVUMF’, how will ‘LABOUR’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'FLEET’ is written as ‘TFMFF',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f1a6587f96ffbbaa123ee01b8d52cb7f33d032beac953d7feccef75d7ea8f28.png] 

For, 'OUTLET’ is written as ‘TOVUMF',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e72f987dc839624977ed86338bdb7a078d4550382d05b499c7721651cff5efa.png] 

Similarly, for '**LABOUR**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d2f62a98672b72d02e67be1d3f44a9e661888cd79e7279a0ea9347ac0fe9851.png] 

So, 'LABOUR' will be written as '**RLBCPV**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
